title: Customer and route analytics in Power BI
tagline: Power BI dashboards for demand, customers and churn, backed by significance tests on sampled routes.

shots.caption: Customer and route analytics in Power BI for Nesma Airlines.
Dashboards were built for demand forecasting, customer segmentation, personalised offers and churn.
Main dashboard: revenue, transactions, passengers and yield.

params.alt: Nesma Airlines sales dashboard in Power BI, with dummy numbers and placeholder names: four KPI tiles for revenue, transactions, passengers and yield, revenue split into seven cards, a daily yield and passengers line chart, and a currency list.

callouts.label: Revenue, passengers, yield at a glance

shots.caption: Filters slice the view by period, source, operation type and sales channel.

params.alt: The same sales dashboard, with dummy numbers, with the filter panel open: ten dropdown slicers, all set to All, with Clear and Close buttons.

shots.caption: Revenue drilled down level by level, by route and agent.

params.alt: Decomposition tree, with dummy numbers, that splits total revenue by source, country, currency, travel agent, route, sector and trip type. Names are placeholders.

shots.caption: Revenue by country as bars, a map and a table.

params.alt: Revenue by country, with dummy numbers, shown as a bar list, a world map and a table. Country names are placeholders.

shots.caption: A star schema: one sales fact table linked one-to-many to lookup tables.

params.alt: Power BI data model with one sales fact table linked one-to-many to lookup tables for fare basis, booking class, sale, action and departure dates, country, travel agent, service type, advance payment, currency and sector routes.

shots.caption: Significance tests on sampled routes checked whether differences were real before acting on them.
